long_biography.plain_text:
Aydınlar trained in business administration and began his career as a certified public accountant. He entered healthcare by taking control of a local Acıbadem hospital, then reinvested earnings, expanded the hospital network and brought the company to the public market. Partnerships with Abraaj and later IHH Healthcare turned the Turkish operator into part of a wider international platform while preserving his substantial ownership and chairmanship.

He now serves as Acıbadem’s chairman and as a non-executive director of IHH Healthcare, with a continuing stake in Acıbadem’s holding company. Beyond hospital operations, he chairs Acıbadem University’s board of trustees, linking his business legacy to medical education, research and clinical training. His brief leadership of the Turkish Football Federation remains a separate public-service chapter outside his healthcare career.
